sourceDepth: Existing source/card and scoped independent G1/G2 evidence retained; no new full-paper, clinical, expert or learner claim

readerCopy.caption: A new report can describe old tissue, and a planned treatment event may be held. Follow specimen identity and the documented record; these fictional days do not prescribe a schedule or explain an outcome.
readerCopy.alt: A shared day-0-to-120 timeline separates biopsy A at day 0 and surgery tissue B at day 100 from treatment plan and record rows. Four treatment events are planned at days 10, 30, 50 and 80; administrations are documented at 10, 50 and 80, while 30 is explicitly held. A day-120 addendum refers back to stored biopsy A, with no new sample.
